verdict.rationale: Docs show you can kick off AI browser agents via a single API call in managed cloud sessions and they execute without a human driving them live (hyperbrowser-docs-1, hyperbrowser-docs-2), which supports autonomous, background-style execution. However there is no evidence of scheduling, recurring/cron triggers, or persistent background job orchestration beyond one-off API-triggered tasks. Missing for 10: scheduled/cron automations, webhook-triggered background runs, job queue/orchestration docs, and independent confirmation of long-running unattended agents.
